newsitem.title: FRANCE: Airbus launches new A340 models.
newsitem.headline: Airbus launches new A340 models.

text.p: Airbus Industrie chief Jean Pierson announced on Sunday at the Paris airshow that the European aircraft consortium was launching two new versions of its A340 four-engine widebody airliner.

Pierson said the commercial launch was for the longer-range A340-500 and the larger-capacity 378-seat A340-600. An Airbus spokesman said the new aircraft will feature a larger wing and stretched body to give the additional capacity.
